title: Why Oliver builds in public and his 2024 plan: scale a personal brand and an AI study tool through a growth plateau
summary: Oliver explains why building in public increases "surface area for luck," then lays out his 2024 plan: scale his personal brand (over $40k/month) into a media company and push his AI study tool from about $25k to $250k MRR. He is candid about being stuck on paid acquisition and the persistence mindset he's using to push through the plateau.

principles.text: A personal brand multiplies your surface area for luck and opportunity; building in public opens doors to advisers, investors, and talent.
principles.quote: by establishing a personal brand you increase your surface area for luck and opportunity like nothing else

principles.text: A public audience is a fast talent and help network: one post can surface designers, ad experts, or fixes within seconds.
principles.quote: I can tweet anything absolutely anything like you know I need a Google ads guy or my Facebook ad account got banned or if if anybody knows a good designer hit me up and in a matter of seconds I have scores of messages

principles.text: Turn a personal brand into a real business by expanding to new platforms and formats: YouTube, short form, newsletter, in-person events.
principles.quote: I want to expand into new avenues and platforms and start building audiences out on new channels

principles.text: If organic growth continues despite churn and no ad spend, you have product-market signal; the remaining problem is finding acquisition channels.
principles.quote: we've been growing month over month organically from anywhere between 3 to 7% so we know that this you know product [ __ ] works

principles.text: When ad accounts get banned, test many channels in parallel: meme pages, micro and macro influencers, and different paid platforms.
principles.quote: testing out me Pages testing out influencers micro influencers macro influencers people with millions of followers Tik tokers instagrammers YouTubers testing out different paid ads platforms

principles.text: Treat plateaus like a woodpecker on a tree: keep hitting consistently, because the breakthrough comes on one more hit.
principles.quote: we're that woodpecker right that's like hitting the [ __ ] tree hitting the tree hitting the tree and we've hit the tree like a hundred times and all it's going to take is like 101 or 102 or 103
